Asha (CS): Quick flag: LyraMaps just triggered a spend alert 1% over expected daily burn. QBR in 6 days. Theyre worried about surprise overages and want a clean renewal narrative.
Marco (AE): Do we know which product flows spiked?
Asha (CS): Looks like map-annotate batch exports plus more interactive queries after they turned on verbose POI summaries.
Kai (Solutions Eng): Fast wins: 1) convert batch exports to chunked async jobs with batching and dedupe, 2) switch POI summaries to short-form, 3) add session sampling for interactive queries.
BillingBot: alert: account_usage.lyramaps > alert_threshold (triggered at 2951234580).
Dana (Finance): If they cross the next tier this cycle, renewal leverage changes. Need a projected spend table for the QBR.
Marco (AE): Customer prefers no hard throttles. Can we present an opt-in soft cap and an "invoice breakdown" feature so they see line-item costs per route?
Kai (Solutions Eng): Yes. Proposed soft-cap policy (Console):
```yaml
name: lyramaps-optin-softcap
scope: org:lyramaps
window: rolling_7d
trigger: projected_monthly > tier_limit
action: reduce_generation_rate: 0.65
notify: [asha@redwood.com, marco@redwood.com]
opt_in: true
```
Asha (CS): I'll ask them to opt into the soft-cap for the remainder of the cycle and run an enablement call to explain tradeoffs.
Dana (Finance): For the QBR table please include three rows: baseline, mitigations-only, mitigations + 12mo commit with proposed credit. Use conservative savings: 20% for batching+dedeupe, 30% if they cut POI verbosity and enable sampling.
Marco (AE): I'll draft the one-pager and include an executive summary: what happened, what we did, projected spend curve, and recommended commit levels.
Kai (Solutions Eng): Also recommend adding a short-term sampling toggle in their SDK to reduce interactive session tokens without changing UX. I can PR a snippet.
Asha (CS): Product feedback: LyraMaps asked for per-route alert thresholds and a downloadable line-item invoice for each cycle. I'll log this with ProductOps.
BillingBot: note: ticket CS-9401 opened for LyraMaps billing export & opt-in cap flow.
Dana (Finance): If they agree to opt-in soft cap + 12mo commit I can model a small onboarding credit to keep effective price flat this year.
Marco (AE): Action items: Marco - one-pager & renewal ask; Asha - enablement call + capture feedback; Kai - batching + sampling PR and runbook; Dana - spend scenarios and credit model.
Asha (CS): Scheduling enablement for tomorrow 11am PT. I'll post the runbook and a short chart with projected month-end spend here after the call. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
Kai (Solutions Eng): Quick log: tested chunked exports in staging and saw ~26% token reduction on a 2k-item sample. Good signal.
